data.choice: Build R79 as a direct-cut 24 fps 1280x720 review conform from the R77 frame map, replacing its pending S15 and S16 baselines with the exact owner-locked R78 scene renders and replacing its provisional S17-C source trim with the exact owner-locked R76 S17-C review render. data.reason: This is the smallest conform that preserves the actual reviewed bytes, scene durations, output clock, narration continuity and prior presenter level repair. It changes assembly state without reopening accepted creative choices.

alternatives.choice: Rebuild the entire episode as one new HyperFrames composition

alternatives.reason_not_selected: That would reintroduce AAC seams and could undo the accepted R58 level repairs; the audited continuous-audio plan is authoritative.

reuse.applies_when: Assembling the current owner-locked EP007 scene package for uninterrupted review.
reuse.avoid_when: A source hash, frame interval, scene duration, narration sample map or owner lock changes.

cut_cues.relation: Direct cuts at the exact half-open output-frame intervals in the updated R79 segment map; no frame may be added, dropped or reordered.
cut_cues.rounding: Frame-exact half-open intervals inherited from R77; final output is 27241 frames.
cut_cues.protected_hold: Preserve every accepted scene ending, S25's intentional pause, S26's complete final card and the 1481-sample EOF pad.
